CommunityApplications.Profile:
Templates for **Mendil**, a self-hosted music bot for TeamSpeak 3 and 6 servers. People type `!play` with a song, a YouTube link or a Spotify link in the channel chat, and Mendil plays it in the voice channel.
- **Mendil** runs the Classic engine: the official TeamSpeak 3 client, headless in the container. - **Mendil-Native** runs the experimental native engine, which speaks the TeamSpeak protocol itself and needs no TeamSpeak client.
Setup guide: https://ulaski.github.io/mendil/guides/unraid/ Bugs and questions: https://github.com/ulaski/mendil/issues
